name: The Akassa raid and its reprisal

summary.text: Shut out of the river trade by the Royal Niger Company’s monopoly, the Nembe of Brass under King Koko attacked the Company’s headquarters at Akassa at dawn on 29 January 1895, killing many of its staff. In February a British naval force answered by shelling and burning Nembe.

routes.label: Koko’s war canoes strike the Company at Akassa

moments.title: Akassa
moments.text: The Company’s depot is sacked and many of its staff killed or captured.

moments.title: Nembe burned
moments.text: A naval force shells and burns Nembe.
